title: Teaching Children Salah and Its Importance in Tarbiyah

text_simplified: The text includes noble Prophetic hadiths speaking of the virtue of salah and the importance of teaching children acts of worship. Experts recommend that parents guide their children toward commitment to salah from a young age. It also points out that raising children upon religious values contributes to building their character.

review_defects.why: The term 'Tarbiyah' is transliterated in the title but translated as 'raising' in the body, creating inconsistency for the same Arabic term.

review_defects.arabic: يوصي الخبراء بضرورة توجيه الأهل لأبنائهم
review_defects.english: Experts recommend that parents guide their children
review_defects.why: The Arabic includes 'بضرورة' (the necessity of), which is omitted in English, softening the recommendation.
